question: Among grown census stages of 15 to 40 junctions where junctions meet at most once, are there non-isomorphic pairs with isomorphic full bond-distance tables and other states?

definitions.states: some full-table isomorphism carries the equation space (cap 5,000)

public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py --out runs/meet-once (8 workers, 16G cap); .venv/bin/python -B pairs_meet.py runs/meet-once; Amendment 1: .venv/bin/python -B pairs_meet2.py runs/meet-once

cheapest_meaningful_control: GROWN-PAIR's 80 meet-once groups up to 14 junctions

amendments.when: after the frozen pairing ran an hour without output, before any pair was read
amendments.change: pairs_meet2.py (sha256 4b4b0f5a6ce9f906c7296d36a1ec3ce289e6382d71c37399fbd9d4d4a61889e4): states decided first on tables pooled at 8 (junction-graph isomorphism, then twin-class enumeration by rank); only other-states classes escalated, under a hard alarm limit; the frozen matcher's edge-label read fixed
amendments.unchanged: M1, M2, population, candidate groups, undecided reading
